Definition: from G1909 and G1209; to admit (as a guest or (figuratively) teacher):--receive.
BiblicalUsage: Epidechomai means to receive, to admit — and Diotrephes, who loves the preeminence, receives not the brethren, and forbids those who would receive them, casting them out of the church.
TheologicalSignificance: Refusing to receive the brethren is refusing Christ's own welcome, and John names it plainly so the church can see it for what it is.
